g.text: cmd: just ao-fetch | pass: prints 'ao-fetch: verified at 2a24f5d3...'; any other commit exits 1
cmd: just ao-build | pass: prints 'ao-build: done' (or 'image already exists, skipping'), exit 0
cmd: just ao-up | pass: prints 'ao-up: both endpoints healthy after N s'; refuses with exit 1 unless just retrieval-up is serving on 8081 and 8082
cmd: just ao-smoke | pass: two PASS lines (backend 127.0.0.1:13001, ingestion 127.0.0.1:13002) and exit 0
cmd: just ao-status | pass: both lines read 'http 200'
cmd: just ao-fixture | pass: prints 'ao-fixture: demo.orders rows=5', exit 0
cmd: just ao-down | pass: podman pod ps lists no auto-ontology pod; ports 13001 and 13002 are free
cmd: just ao-down | pass: podman pod ps lists no auto-ontology pod; ports 13001 and 13002 are free
